threads.body: [General] This example no longer implements `ComponentProvider`'s required `getName()` and `getType()` methods, so it cannot be compiled as shown. Include both methods as in the actual providers (for example, `ThreadDetailsComponentProvider`) to keep the documented bridge usage copyable.
not sure if it makes sense to extract an object that contains all of those properties (all but `path`)

looks like can stay private
```suggestion
  private final ConfigProperties configProperties;
```

The component-local mode still inherits the adapter's instrumentation-only special cases: `SPECIAL_MAPPINGS` is checked before prefix translation, while `getLong` and `getStructuredList` also hard-code `java.jmx.discovery.delay` and `java.common.service_peer_mapping`. A component key matching one of these paths therefore escapes `configPropertyPrefix`; for example, `general.http.client.request_captured_headers` reads the global `otel.instrumentation...` key instead of the requested component namespace. Gate all three special-case paths to the full instrumentation-config mode.

threads.body: [General] This promises the same component-local shape, but the returned implementation does not satisfy several `DeclarativeConfigProperties` semantics: `getPropertyKeys()` is always empty, `getStructured()` never returns `null` for a missing child, non-string scalar lists are unsupported, and component-mode structured lists are always unavailable. Components using those APIs therefore behave differently for flat config and YAML. Please document these limitations on this new public entry point (or narrow the guarantee) so external consumers do not assume full interchangeability.

threads.body: [General] Component mode still uses the instrumentation-name translator, so `backup_diagnostic_files` becomes `backup-diagnostic-files`. With the documented prefix this reads `otel.inferred.spans.backup-diagnostic-files`, not the existing `otel.inferred.spans.backup.diagnostic.files`; `min_duration` is similarly unable to reach `min.duration`. Keep the hyphen translation for complete instrumentation config, but translate component-local underscores to flat `.` separators.

replies.body: No code change: No code change needed. DefaultConfigProperties normalizes property keys with ConfigUtil.normalizePropertyKey(), which replaces hyphens with periods, so otel.inferred.spans.backup-diagnostic-files resolves the existing otel.inferred.spans.backup.diagnostic.files and min-duration resolves min.duration. A component-specific underscore-to-dot rule cannot be inferred from a prefix and would introduce undocumented mode-dependent behavior; non-normalizing custom ConfigProperties implementations would require explicit mappings.
